page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Notes in the right margin beside paragraphs 1 to 5. Catchword at the lower right, signature at the foot.

main_text.head: CAPUT I. DE FIDE CHRISTIANA CHRISTIANISMI.
SECTIO I.
main_text.p: FIDES CHRISTIANA respicit vel doctrinam credendorum Christiano ad salutem, vel hominem Christianum, in quo est, & per quam hic credens & fidelis est.Distinctio vocis Fidei. [?]
I. FIDES respiciens doctrinam, tradit salutarem ex verbo Dei sapientiam credendorum Christiano ad salutem.I. Respectu doctrinae. [?]
Credenda haec breviter constringuntur Symbolo Apostolico, quod est breve quoddam rerum creditu ad salutem necessariarum compendium.Credenda in Symbolo Apostolico.
Partes Symboli huius duae sunt, una de Deo, altera de Ecclesia.Partes Symboli.
In Deo considerantur Essentia ejus & Personae. Essentia Dei est absoluta per-Essentia Dei.

page.notes: The woodcut initial F is decorated and joined to the first word. The printed "vocis" and "respectu" in the margin are hard to read at this scan resolution and are marked [?]. The handwritten "216 a" in the top right corner is a library mark and is left out. A dark stain at the lower centre is left out. The catchword "fectif-" is partly faint.
